description: This file defines an internal class Encoding within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing static methods for encoding and decoding strings and reading multiple strings from a buffer.
external_files: none explicitly referenced, but relies on PHP core functions

classes.name: Encoding
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string encoding and decoding, used internally within the AWS CRT PHP SDK.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string from the buffer and advances the buffer pointer.

methods.name: readStrings
methods.description: Reads multiple strings from the buffer until the buffer is exhausted.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a length-prefixed string from the buffer, returning the length and the string.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string into a length-prefixed binary format suitable for transmission or storage.
